late.coordinate: Immediately before the only explicit thinking close

final.requires: Native EOS, exactly one thinking close, complete official scalar readout and a same-original-object scoped commitment that agrees numerically with that readout
final.scope_check: Use the same strict affirmative original-subject grammar on the final channel. A separate blind role review may validate the exact terminal box and its same-target preceding context as sensitivity. Never use final text to issue an earlier certificate.
final.unknown_or_ineligible: Retain original delivery. Do not silently substitute an earlier bound after unknown scope, format failure, infeasibility, cap or uncertain termination. Record such cases independently.

preservation.positive_authority: Only a run-local exact feasibility proof tied to the observed prefix, original scope and full constraints can issue a certificate. Matching includes unit and direction. Feasible does not imply globally optimal.
preservation.update: MAX accepts strictly larger feasible values; MIN accepts strictly smaller feasible values. Preserve earliest verified evidence at an exact tie. Unknown, bad binding, wrong direction and infeasible values never overwrite it.
preservation.comparison: A feasible regression requires two independently verified values for exactly the same original objective and unit, with the native final strictly worse. A raw better candidate that fails feasibility is not evidence of regression.

gate: At least two new independent valid questions with true verified feasible-to-feasible regressions, residual need beyond the same-evidence simple retention and a short ordinary exact solution, and no clear false authorization. Preserve native correctness, label conflicts and all costs. If gate fails, no GPU.
